subject: Re: Service Coverage SKUs and Quarterly Support Options
messages:
From: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@cardinalai.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coverage SKU breakdown and SLA questions

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the overview earlier. Procurement asked me to get a clean SKU/pricing breakdown for your premium support packages (we're evaluating both Hosted and Dedicated options). Specifically we need:
- Monthly price by support SKU (tiered availability: 99.9 / 99.95 / 99.99)
- P1/P2/P3 response SLA targets and on-call escalation coverage (hours & phone)
- Any commit / annual discount thresholds and what they require (min monthly $)
- Sample SLA addendum language for a 99.99 availability target and associated credit calc

Can you also confirm whether named technical account management / 24/7 phone escalation is included or a separate add-on? Procurement attached our RFP and standard procurement terms.

We'd like this by COB Friday if possible — Cardinal is targeting an Oct 1 start if terms align.

Thanks,
Kelly
Kelly Tran
Sr. Product Ops, Cardinal AI
--
Attachment: Cardinal_RFP_09012027.pdf (pdf)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@cardinalai.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage SKU breakdown and SLA questions

Kelly — thanks for the RFP and the clear ask. Drafted three recommended coverage SKUs below (attached spreadsheet has line-item pricing and SKU codes):

1) Standard (RD-SUP-STD) — Hosted
   - Availability: 99.9%
   - P1 response: 4 hours (business hours), P2: 8 hours, P3: 48 hours
   - Coverage: Biz hours (M-F 8a-6p PT), ticket and email; on-call phone available as an add-on
   - Monthly: $6,500

2) Premium (RD-SUP-PRM) — Hosted or Dedicated
   - Availability: 99.95%
   - P1 response: 1 hour (business hours), 30 min for on-call P1; P2: 4 hours
   - Coverage: 24/7 pager for P1, named Technical Account Manager (TAM) during business hours
   - Monthly: $18,000

3) Enterprise Platinum (RD-SUP-PLT) — Dedicated recommended for 99.99
   - Availability: 99.99% (Dedicated deployment + SLA addendum)
   - P1 response: 30 minutes (24/7), P2: 2 hours, P3: 8 hours
   - Coverage: 24/7 phone escalation, named TAM + quarterly reviews, on-site white-glove onboarding option
   - Monthly: $42,000

Discounts and commits:
- 12 month prepay: 10% off monthly list
- 24 month prepay: 18% off monthly list
- Committed spend floors: to unlock >15% discounts, require >= $375k ARR for the support contract

SLA credits (summary):
- 99.9 target: credit = 5% of monthly support for a single month breach
- 99.95 target: credit = 10%
- 99.99 target: credit = 20% (requires Dedicated + infrastructure annex)

Named TAM and phone escalation: included in Premium and Platinum; Standard may add phone as $2,500/mo add-on.

I've attached the SKU spreadsheet (Redwood_Premium_SKUs_20270902.xlsx) and a draft SLA addendum (SLA_TERM_DRAFT_v2.docx). If you can confirm expected monthly platform spend (token/usage baseline) we can recommend the minimum tier and whether we can apply any promotional discount for a first-year commit.

Happy to jump on a quick call — are you available tomorrow?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Premium_SKUs_20270902.xlsx (xlsx), SLA_TERM_DRAFT_v2.docx (docx)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-02T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Cardinal — discount authority and margin check

Marcus / Monica — quick internal: Cardinal asked for potential discounting (they'll try for 20–25%). My initial positions:
- Offer up to 15% from sales list price for a 12-month commit (no prepay)
- For anything >15% we should escalate to Rishi (head of sales ops) — need exec discount approval and finance sign-off
- 99.99 availability should require Dedicated deployment + legal SLA addendum (expects extra indemnities)

Margin impact: Platinum at $42k/mo with 15% discount -> $35.7k/mo. If we go 22% it becomes $32.76k — still above our threshold if they commit to platform spend + Dedicated margin uplift.

Can you confirm the highest approved discount we can promise in writing before involving Rishi and Legal? Also advise on whether we can waive the one-time onboarding fee ($12k) as a commercial concession.

Thanks,
Laura
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-02T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Cardinal — discount authority and margin check

Laura —
Short: sales can approve up to 15% (standard playbook). Anything between 15–20% requires approval from sales ops (Rishi) and finance; >20% requires CRO/CEO signoff.
We should try to get them to take Platinum with a 12-month prepay to keep effective discount below 18% while giving them headline 20+.
Onboarding fee: waiveable up to $6k by sales; anything beyond needs finance approval.

If you need, I'll draft the commercial terms that reflect a 18% prepay discount but show a one-time $6k off to make headline feel larger.

-Marcus
From: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@cardinalai.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, procurement@cardinalai.com
Date: 2027-09-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage SKU breakdown and SLA questions

Laura — appreciate the options. Cardinal's position: to prioritize reliability we need 99.99 in primary region (we run critical customer-facing features) and 24/7 phone escalation with named SE.
Commercial ask: 25% discount off list for the first 12 months and then revert to list with a true-up. Our projected support spend target is $50k/mo (platform spend excluded) — if you can cap the monthly at $50k we can commit to a 12-month term today.

Also want credits capped at an agreed maximum per incident and a clear escalation SLA (phone pickup <15 minutes for P1s). Procurement attached their standard terms (redlines included).

Can you confirm whether 99.99 will be provided on Hosted or only Dedicated?

Thanks,
Kelly
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@cardinalai.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-04T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage SKU breakdown and SLA questions

Kelly — thanks, direct answers:
- 99.99 availability: we can offer it only on Dedicated deployments as it requires isolated pools, hot standby and additional SRE runbooks; hosted catalogue defaults to 99.95 unless you sign the Dedicated SLA addendum.
- Phone pickup <15 minutes for P1 is aggressive but acceptable for Platinum with Dedicated + named SEs (we'll put that into the SLA).

Commercial counter:
- We can approve up to 18% off list for a 12-month prepay on the Platinum SKU if Cardinal commits to a minimum $40k/mo support spend and a platform usage baseline (this reduces variance risk).
- To hit 25% we'd need a 24-month contract + $750k ARR commitment or CRO approval.
- We can waive onboarding fee entirely as a one-time concession if you sign within 7 business days.

I'll escalate to Rishi for a one-time deeper discount if Cardinal wants a 12-month without prepay. Can you confirm whether procurement will accept the Dedicated SLA annex and the required indemnity language? If yes, I will route for approval.

Best,
Laura
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-05T13:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage SKU breakdown and SLA questions — exec review

Laura / Monica — reviewed. Given Cardinal's strategic fit and potential for Dedicated expansion, I approve a one-time 22% discount on Platinum for a 12-month term provided the following conditions are met:
1) Minimum committed support spend: $40k/mo (annualized $480k)
2) Cardinal signs the Dedicated SLA addendum as-is (Legal to review indemnity + audit clauses)
3) Onboarding fee waived; 30-day performance review clause included
4) Finance will issue invoices monthly with net-30 and require the PO on file

I'll take responsibility for escalating beyond this if the customer pushes to 25% (CRO signoff). Please include Monica in the commercial terms and route to Legal for SLA finalization.

Rishi
From: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@cardinalai.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, procurement@cardinalai.com

Subject: Re: Coverage SKU breakdown and SLA questions — acceptance

Laura / Team — thanks. Cardinal accepts the 22% one-time discount on the Platinum Dedicated bundle, commits to $500k total support spend for the 12 month term, will sign the Dedicated SLA addendum, and confirms onboarding fee waiver. Attached is the signed PO (Cardinal_PO_20270908.pdf).

Please send the DocuSign package for MSA + SLA and the first invoice — requested start date: 2027-10-01.

Appreciate the responsiveness.
Kelly
